name: manychat-ig-lead-magnet
description: Create or prepare Instagram comment-to-DM lead magnet workflows using a PDF, public resource link, or GitHub skill and ManyChat automation. Use when the user wants to turn a source asset such as a YouTube video, podcast, post, Slack/Hermes output, or existing PDF into a lead magnet, choose the right comment keyword(s), upload the PDF into ManyChat, add tracking tags/fields, QA the flow, and set it up so people can comment on an Instagram post/reel and receive the resource by DM or after an email
author: ericosiu
